Both parts exist when y ≤ min(2t, 3/2 − t). The crossover between the two cases of the min occurs at y = 3 − 4t.

**Case A** (y ≤ 3 − 4t): width = t − y/2.
**Case B** (y > 3 − 4t): width = 3/2 − t − y.

$$A(t) = \int_0^{2t}\!\left(t - \tfrac{y}{2}\right)dy = t^2.$$
